svg.title: Diffusion model quantization
svg.desc: Animation: a picture denoises out of random noise four times, as FP16, INT8, INT4 and INT8 with fewer steps, while a histogram of UNet activations stays smooth at 8 bits and snaps onto 16 levels at 4 bits. The table gives the notebook's measured seconds per image and CLIPScore for each mode: fake quantization alone is slower than FP16, INT4 loses quality, and cutting to 20 steps gives a 27 % latency cut.
svg.text: Group project: Q-Diffusion-style PTQ on Stable Diffusion 1.5
